paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，在理论上建立了结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的紧密联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS3.p1]。该框架表明，SSM 与结构化掩码注意力（SMA）在特定情形下互为对偶，同时具有线性时间与二次时间两种形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于此，作者设计了新的 SSD 算法，其专用实现比 Mamba 的优化选择性扫描快 2-8 倍，并允许更大的循环状态 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者进一步提出 Mamba-2 架构，在语言建模上保持与 Transformer 竞争力，并在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3][S9.F9]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间丰富的理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法与系统优化迁移到 SSM 上 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的集体努力显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解、实验和高效训练 [S1.p1]。其目标是构建在序列长度上扩展更高效、同时性能优于 Transformer 的基础模型 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: However, the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.
Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（尤其是半可分矩阵）的抽象来连接 SSM 与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。核心思想是将 SSM 写成矩阵变换形式，证明其等价于半可分矩阵，从而把 SSM 的高效计算归结为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。作者还从张量收缩角度重新证明线性注意力，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.p1]。在此基础上，论文提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的 SSD 算法，结合线性循环与二次对偶形式 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
Equation ( 3) directly establishes the link between state space models and the sequentially semiseparable representation
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
The main results in this section are a simple tensor-contraction-based proof of linear attention ( Proposition 4.1), and our generalized abstraction of structured masked attention in Definition 4.2.
we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode

experiments.text: 论文在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估 Mamba-2，使用更难的任务、更长序列和更小模型，并与多头 softmax 注意力及 Based 架构比较 [S9.SS1.p2]。语言建模方面，模型规模从 125M 到 2.7B，遵循 GPT3 规格，在 Pile 数据集上训练，并与 Mamba 和 Transformer++ 比较困惑度及零样本评测 [S9.SS2.p1]。速度基准上，将 SSD 算法与 Mamba 的扫描实现及 FlashAttention-2 对比 [S9.SS3.p1]。此外还消融了 Mamba-2 架构的多种设计选择 [S9.p1]。

evidence.quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Finally, we ablate various design choices in the Mamba-2 architecture ( Section 9.4).

findings.text: SSD 算法比 Mamba 的融合扫描快 2-8 倍，并在序列长度 2K 及以上快于 FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-1 表现挣扎，而 Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，且即使控制状态大小（N=16）也显著优于 Mamba-1 [S9.SS1.p3]。语言建模中，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S9.F9]；2.7B 参数、在 Pile 上训练 300B token 的 Mamba-2 优于 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。混合 SSD 与注意力层（约 10% 注意力层）优于纯 Mamba-2 或 Transformer++ [S9.SS2.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length $2K$.
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ( $\mathtt{N}=16$).
Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B
a mixture of SSD and attention layers outperforms the pure Mamba-2 or Transformer++ architecture.

limitations.text: 作者指出，SSD 相比此前结构化 SSM 的主要限制在于状态转移 A_t 的表达能力，SSD 仅使用更受限的对角结构，以表达力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者假设或许可以改进结构化矩阵算法以推广到一般对角 SSM 情形 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p2]。此外，Mamba-2 整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层而 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。作者还提到，Mamba-2 在 MQAR 上显著优于 Mamba-1 的具体原因尚不确定，留待未来工作探索 [S9.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency (and ease of implementation).
We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)
We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.
